# dataiku_user (Data Source)

Reads a single Dataiku DSS user by login. Requires an API key with admin rights.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dataiku_user" "admin" {
  login = "admin"
}

output "admin_groups" {
  value = data.dataiku_user.admin.groups
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `login` (String) Login of the user to read.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name of the user.
- `email` (String) Email address of the user.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user may sign in.
- `groups` (List of String) Names of the groups the user belongs to.
- `id` (String) The user's login.
- `source_type` (String) Where the user is defined, `LOCAL` or `LDAP`.
- `user_profile` (String) License profile assigned to the user.
